text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: cont-batch streaming path p99 spike > 7s in us-west-2 (svc: /v1/stream/generate). SLO breach (p99 > 5s). Symptoms: streaming stalls, tail spikes. Links: https://splunk/recent/6054321987, https://grafana/contbatch/usw2. Incident ID: INC-20260503-73.

alice_parker: acknowledged, taking lead. tagging @frank_oncall for paging rotation. I’m oncall and will triage now.

ben_lee: seeing correlated increase in contbatch queue depth and many mixed-seqlen batches. p95 looks fine but p99 jumps when mixed batches hit 16+ seqs. logs show repeated kv-cache evictions for those requests.

carla_ops: customer impact: a handful of high-throughput customers report streaming stalls and reconnects — ~3% of connections retried in last 10m. No 5xx spike but far more timeouts on client side. Slack thread from cust-team: "users see partial streams then stall".

dave_sre: quick check: node-level metrics show CPU on batcher pods ~85%, GPU util steady. Batcher backlog spiking, scheduling latency up. Could be packer creating very large logical batches when short and long seqs mix.

erin_prod: can we flip contbatch to conservative mode for streaming routes (reduce max_batch_size to 8) as a live mitigation? config flag: routing.contbatch.streaming.max_batch=8. Will that require deploy?

alice_parker: good idea. frank, can you apply config override to us-west streaming fleet? We should also enable fallback to streaming-small model variant for sessions that exceed seqlen 8192.

frank_oncall: applying override now to usw2-contbatch-streamers (staged). Command: ```rbctl set-config --env=usw2 --route=/v1/stream/generate --key=routing.contbatch.streaming.max_batch --value=8 --reason="live mitigation p99 spike"```

frank_oncall: ran it. Waiting for rollout (~30s). Watching p99.

ben_lee: while that rolls, I’m going to throttle packer prefetch: patching packer to avoid greedy packing of many short requests with one long. Small change: packer.max_pack_span=50ms -> 30ms. Pushing canary to two pods.

carla_ops: updated customer-success with a note: "We are applying temporary configuration to reduce batch size on streaming to mitigate stalls. Expect improved streaming continuity within ~2-5 min. We will follow up."

dave_sre: telemetry: after override p99 dropped from 7.4s to 3.2s in first 90s for the route. GPU and CPU stable. backlog decreased ~60%. Good signal.

erin_prod: rolling fallback rule to stream-small variant for sequences > 6k tokens now: ```routing.fallback.rule: if seq_len_percentile(95) > 6000 -> model=stream-small-v2``` Applying in us-west.

alice_parker: agree keep both mitigations for 20m then reassess. Ben, continue canary for packer change, if green promote. Dave, monitor for regression or error modes (truncation).

ben_lee: packer canary looks ok on two pods for last 5m. No increased 5xx. Latency distribution tightened. Preparing rollout to 50% of packers in usw2.

frank_oncall: note: we also saw a KV-eviction flood on node batcher-17 around 6054321900 correlated with one noisy tenant doing long-context streaming. We should throttle that tenant if this reoccurs. Logged tenant id: t-98877 in INC ticket.

carla_ops: queued customer outreach to tenant t-98877 contact@biguser.com — flagged for rate-limiting if next 10m of traffic remains high.

dave_sre: monitoring: after packer rollout to 50% and fallback rule, p99 stabilized ~2.8s and streaming reconnect rate down to 0.8%. Marking incident as mitigated for now.

alice_parker: prep incident summary for handoff. Current state: mitigated, continued monitoring. Open follow-ups: (1) root cause RCA for packer packing heuristics with mixed seqlen (owner: ben), (2) better per-tenant circuit-breaker for long-context streams (owner: dave), (3) postmortem and runbook update for streaming contbatch live mitigations (owner: alice).

frank_oncall: handing off to next oncall @dave_sre at 6054322300. Summary: applied max_batch=8 override, packer max_pack_span lowered on canary then 50%, fallback to stream-small for long seqs; p99 reduced from 7.4s->2.8s; customer reconnects reduced. See INC-20260503-73 for logs/actions.

dave_sre: taking over monitoring. If any re-escalation, ping me. I’ll kick off a deeper trace for KV eviction patterns.

alice_parker: thanks team. adding :white_check_mark: to thread when postmortem draft is up.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260503-73 status -> mitigated. Created ticket PM-4562 for RCA. Playbooks updated: last change by alice_parker."
